description: This file defines the Marketing model class for the Opencart e-commerce platform, providing methods to retrieve marketing details by code and to add marketing reports to the database.

classes.name: Marketing
classes.description: A model class for handling marketing-related database operations such as retrieving marketing info by code and adding marketing reports.

methods.name: getMarketingByCode
methods.description: Retrieves marketing information by a specified code from the database.

methods.name: addReport
methods.description: Inserts a new marketing report record into the database, capturing details such as marketing ID, IP address, and country.
